hero.description: We understand the operational realities of the Hajj sector, improve processes, connect systems and data, and apply AI to build solutions that increase efficiency, improve service quality, and support better decisions.
hero.primaryCta: Start with a Data & KPI Assessment

whyEstidam.titleMuted: Better Operations. Practical Intelligence. Measurable Impact.
whyEstidam.description: We combine Hajj-sector understanding, operational transformation, and strong technology and delivery capabilities to build solutions that start with real business needs and continue through operation and improvement.
whyEstidam.card1Text: Solutions designed around the realities of Hajj companies and seasonal operations.
whyEstidam.card2Text: Define the challenge and desired outcome first, then select the right technology.
whyEstidam.card3Text: Embed AI into processes, data and decision support.
whyEstidam.card4Text: Track performance, learn from delivery, and continuously improve outcomes.

hajjJourney.titleMuted: During and After the Hajj Season
hajjJourney.description: We support companies across the full Hajj operating cycle — from preparation and readiness, through peak-season execution, to post-season analysis and continuous improvement.
hajjJourney.phase1Text: Operational and system readiness ahead of the season, built on a clear plan.
hajjJourney.phase1CardStatus: Operational readiness ahead of the season
hajjJourney.phase1CardNote: Turning complexity into a coordinated, ready season.
hajjJourney.phase2Text: Real-time operational control during peak activity, with fast response and coordinated decisions.
hajjJourney.phase2CardNote: Keeping every moving part aligned when demand peaks.
hajjJourney.phase3Text: Post-season learning that turns performance data into clearer plans for the next cycle.
hajjJourney.phase3CardStatus: Insights ready for the next cycle
hajjJourney.phase3CardNote: Closing the loop with measurable improvement.

solutions.description: We do not start with a predefined product or technology. We understand the challenge and the operating process first, then build or integrate the solution best suited to the required outcomes.
solutions.itemText: Redesign processes, improve workflows and identify automation opportunities.
solutions.itemHighlight: Clearer operating paths with less friction before peak season.

operations.description: We apply AI where it can improve execution speed, information flow, team productivity and decision-making, while first considering the readiness of processes, data and systems.

products.description: Some challenges repeat across the sector. When a problem is validated and a solution proves its value, it can evolve into a reusable and scalable digital product that serves a wider set of organizations.
products.card1Tagline: A compliance and evidence platform that turns manual procedures into a trusted digital record.
products.card1Problem: Scattered evidence and hard-to-prove compliance across departments and agencies.
products.card1Users: Governance and compliance units in government and semi-government entities.
products.card2Tagline: An operations command layer that connects seasonal workflows, teams and live performance signals.
products.card2Problem: Fragmented seasonal operations with weak visibility across sites, shifts and service partners.
products.card2Users: Operations leaders and control-room teams in Hajj companies.
products.card3Tagline: Decision support that turns operational data into clear priorities before and during the season.
products.card3Problem: Too many metrics, too little actionable guidance when pressure peaks.
products.card3Users: Planning, analytics and executive teams seeking faster decisions.
products.card4Tagline: A field coordination product that keeps frontline teams aligned with central operations.
products.card4Problem: Delayed updates between field teams and headquarters during peak movement.
products.card4Users: Field supervisors and dispatch teams across seasonal sites.
